title: F&F SAT full-length test import file
description: One self-contained JSON file describing a complete SAT practice test: metadata, embedded image assets and ordered modules of ordered questions. Version 2.0. Files written for the September 2026 importer (no formatVersion, inline Markdown images) are also valid.

formatVersion.description: Version of this format the file was written for. Use "2.0".

testId.description: Stable identifier for the test (e.g. "dsat-2026-11"). Re-importing a file with an existing testId never overwrites that test; it can only be imported as a separate copy.

isAdaptive.description: false (default when every section has one Module 2) imports a fixed-form test. true requires, per routed section, a Module 1 and Module 2 variants tagged with difficultyTrack "Easy"/"Standard"/"Hard". Students scoring at least 60% on Module 1 are routed to Hard.

routing.description: Optional. Only a 60% threshold on the Module 1 result is supported; anything else is reported as an error.

breakMinutes.description: Break between the Reading and Writing and the Math sections. Default 10.

totalTimeMinutes.description: Optional. Defaults to the sum of the module time limits.

assets.description: Images used anywhere in the test. Reference one from text with ![alt text](asset:ID), or from an image field with "asset:ID". One asset may be referenced by any number of questions.

vocabulary.description: Optional. SAT vocabulary words to add to the shared vocabulary bank when an admin or mentor saves the test. Same fields as a vocabulary upload; a word already in the bank is updated (mentors only update words they created). Questions may also carry their own "vocabulary" list.

modules.description: Modules in the order students take them.

data.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (no data: prefix needed, but a data URI is accepted). The decoded image must be 3 MB or smaller and must really be of the declared mimeType.

alt.description: Default alternative text, used when a reference gives none.

fileName.description: Optional original filename. A Markdown image that names this file (e.g. ![x](graph_08.png)) resolves to this asset.

richText.description: Plain text, Markdown or HTML. Supported Markdown: paragraphs (blank line), line breaks (single newline), **bold**, *italic*, <u>underline</u>, <sub>/<sup>, - bullet and 1. numbered lists, > quotes, # headings, GitHub-style pipe tables (header row + --- separator; :---: alignment), and images ![alt](data:image/png;base64,…) or ![alt](asset:ID). Math: $inline$ and $$display$$ LaTeX.

difficultyTrack.description: "Baseline" for Module 1. For adaptive Module 2 variants: "Easy", "Standard" or "Hard".

questions.description: Questions in the order students see them.

id.description: A, B, C, D in that order.

questionNumber.description: Should equal the question's 1-based position in its module.

image.description: Optional figure shown above the passage (or above the prompt when there is no passage).

vocabulary.description: Optional vocabulary words used in this question; added to the shared bank with the test.

correctAnswer.description: MCQ: the option id. SPR: the answer as a student would type it (e.g. "36.75" or "3/4").

acceptableAnswers.description: SPR only: other forms that also score as correct. Equivalent fractions and decimals already match.
